name: Southern bush monkeyflower
desc: Southern bush monkeyflower (Diplacus longiflorus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 180 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Diplacus longiflorus, commonly known as southern bush monkeyflower, is a species of monkeyflower native to southwestern California (United States) and Baja California Norte (Mexico).
